title: Land cover, 2021
summary: What covers the ground (trees, cropland, built-up areas, water and more), used to describe candidate sites.
method: Clipped from Earth Engine to the pilot bounding box plus 0.05 degrees and resampled by nearest neighbour to about 20 m.
limitations: A classification model with known errors between similar classes.
The 2020 and 2021 editions use different algorithms, so comparing them is not valid change detection.
